t: These S-shape Christmas light gutter hooks provide a simple solution for hanging outdoor festive decorations. Designed for quick installation, this 36 pack is ideal for homeowners dressing roofs, gutters, and eaves. Constructed from lightweight and durable black plastic, each hook clips effortlessly onto standard guttering systems, allowing the hanging of string lights. The plastic is designed for outdoor use, ensuring decorations remain securely in place throughout the winter months.
b: S-Shape Hooks Fit Most Gutters & Eaves
Practical 36 Pack Covers Large Seasonal Displays
Lightweight Material for Quick & Effortless Installation
Versatile Design Holds String Lights & Hanging Decorations
